At 4:21 a.m. on March 5th, THEP warships arrived at the testing site of their first-ever nuclear device, a small  island in the Amaralo ocean, officially codenamed "The Bright Bit". This time, they were returning for a second roundanother nuclear weapon had been manufactured, and its imminent test loomed. Confirmed presence included ships from Hydronia and the BR. Bob, with speculation swirling about potential involvement from Italian-Dutch and New Westmore forces, both also members of the Security COuncil.

By 6:00 a.m. sharp, the device was detonated. A blinding flash lit up the sky above the island for several seconds, followed by the emergence of a towering mushroom cloud rising ominously over the tranquil landmass. This new device is estimated to be approximately 20 kilotonssignificantly larger than the previous test conducted just weeks earlier.
